This chapter describes how kintera computes photolysis rates. A photolysis reaction is listed in the `reactions`[^rg-8146dd1c4e5b]
block with `type: photolysis`. Its cross sections are read per branch, from inline YAML or from a KINETICS7 file,
on a wavelength grid and optionally on several temperatures. The rate constant of each reaction is the
dissociative cross section times the actinic flux, integrated over wavelength. The `PhotoChem` module multiplies
the rate constants by the reactant concentrations and returns the reaction rates and their Jacobian, in the same
reaction-space form as the thermal kinetics of @sec-ch06. The actinic flux itself is an input: kintera supplies
helpers to build or interpolate one, but no radiative transfer.

The dependency map of the schemes is not provided: the figure module is not written yet.

| scheme | YAML key or option | default | main test |
|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch07-cross-sections | `cross-section`, `branches` | YAML format | `test_photolysis_options` |
| @sec-ch07-actinic-flux | `ActinicFluxOptions` (API) | unit flux | `test_actinic_flux` |
| @sec-ch07-rate | `type: photolysis` | trapezoidal rule | `test_photolysis_options` |
| @sec-ch07-photochem | `PhotoChem` (API) | always | `test_photolysis_kinetics` |
| @sec-ch07-kinetics-base | `from_kinetics_base` (API) | caller | `test_kinetics_base` |
